attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as the DNS resolver for the shared 10.100.11.0/24 network using PowerDNS Recursor (service dns forwarding): listens on 10.100.11.10, allows queries from the /24, forwards to 1.1.1.1/9.9.9.9 upstream, and serves an authoritative A record for inventory.internal -> 10.100.11.11 (node2). node2 and node3 were reconfigured via nmcli (ipv4.dns=10.100.11.10, ipv4.ignore-auto-dns=yes) to resolve through node1. Verified inventory.internal resolves to node2's address and external names (google.com) resolve via upstream forwarding from both node2 and node3. Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id/service baselines, rebooted one node at a time via native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and re-verified DNS config/resolution after each restart.
